subject: Small ACL fixes (#71)
reason: The change is build-system and test-only: src/CMakeLists.txt adds the pre-existing acl.cc to the CMake build (a link fix for symbols the command files already referenced), testing/CMakeLists.txt adds a unit-test target, vmsdk's testing_infra teardown change affects only the mock used by unit tests, and the acl.cc/acl.h edits are comment typo fixes. No runtime behavior of the loaded module differs between the two builds — the AclPrefixCheck logic is identical — so no command reply, persistence or replication path can distinguish them; a compared sequence would have no command to mark expect_dif
